scenes.speech: You know that feeling when your coding agent finishes a change, and it works, but you couldn't quite explain it yet?
That's why we made Own it. When you push, it asks a few short questions about what changed, right in your terminal.
Say you added payment retries. Why? So a temporary error doesn't lose the sale. Just explain it in your own words.
You get feedback, and a passing debrief marks those commits as verified. Busy right now? You can always come back later.
Keep building with your coding agent. Give yourself a moment to understand what you're shipping. That's Own it.
